title: Runtime Step 00: Competence Gate
summary: Default-denies consequential execution when expertise, context, tools, authority, or independence are critically missing.
mechanism: Five honest checks run before substantive reasoning. The result is hard-locked so a later stage cannot retroactively invent competence.
test_status: Implemented in the frozen runtime and included in built-in self-tests; external behavioral validation remains open.
next_tests: Tool outage and authority spoofing tests
